label: French
source_guidance: Interpret French tense, grammatical gender, tu/vous and interpersonal relationships. Grammatical gender alone does not establish a character’s gender.
target_guidance: Use natural French with consistent tense, gender/number agreement and tu/vous register. Handle elision and accents correctly.
punctuation_rule: Follow French punctuation and quotation spacing conventions. Preserve accents, apostrophes, symbol structure and pairing.
title_rule: Use French title and section-label conventions, including French capitalization.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
